intent.statement: Port the approved incompatible Chunking project-open self-heal into the actual Audiomancer V2 workspace so recovered projects activate normally instead of surfacing the legacy Reset Chunking error

examples: An old chunks_text.json missing required current fields is deleted; translation, speech and audio outputs are reset; the second validation returns an openable project result.
spec_items.statement: When open_project encounters an IncompatibleChunkingDocumentError caused by invalid persisted content, it resets Chunking plus every configured downstream operation and invokes project validation exactly one more time.

examples: source book.pdf, extraction_metadata.json, extracted_text.txt, cleanup.json, and clean_text.txt retain their bytes after recovery.
spec_items.statement: Chunking self-heal leaves the selected source, Extraction metadata/text, Cleanup document/text, project identity, and project options unchanged while resetting Chunking and downstream manifest summaries to not_started at text_chunking_ready.

examples: A stale chunking_checkpoint.json is removed by both explicit and automatic Chunking reset.
spec_items.statement: Reset Chunking owns chunks_text.json, chunking_checkpoint.json, obsolete chunking_state.json and chunking_report.json, and matching Chunking AI logs, but owns no upstream artifact.

examples: PermissionError reading chunks_text.json leaves chunks_text.json and every downstream artifact unchanged.
spec_items.statement: An operating-system read failure wrapped by Chunking document loading is re-raised by project opening and causes no reset or validation retry.

examples: English and Romanian messages convey the same recovery meaning after project activation.
spec_items.statement: A successful automatic Chunking recovery marks the open result; after activating that project, Home displays one localized informational warning that Cleanup was preserved and Chunking plus downstream results must be regenerated.
